title: Remove dead getNonDuplicateCopyablePomodoroBullets helper in task-status-cycler
description: While planning the Pomodoro carry-forward grouping change, I found that getNonDuplicateCopyablePomodoroBullets() in the bob-plugins repo (plugins/task-status-cycler/main.js, ~line 1902) is dead code: it has no callers in main.js, is not listed in module.exports.helpers, and is not referenced by scripts/test-task-status-cycler.cjs. Pomodoro carry-forward planning in buildPomodoroCompletionPlan() does its own inline copy construction and never de-duplicates against existing target keys, so the helper (and possibly getPomodoroSubBulletTargetKeys(), which is only used by it) is leftover from an earlier design. Proposal: confirm both are unreachable, then delete them, and run npm test + npm run validate in bob-plugins.
